name: Spell Subterfuge

source.note: Compared with the published D&D Beyond chapter on 2026-10-06: https://www.dndbeyond.com/sources/dnd/au/chapter-1-character-options.

summary: Reference-only: after an action-time slotted spell, a Bonus Action lets you both Dash and Hide. Uses equal the modifier of the ability increased by this feat, per Long Rest. Reference-only: while Invisible from Hide, a Verbal component or spell attack does not end that condition if you finish the turn behind Three-Quarters or Total Cover.
